differences.what: massing: the main block's two brick storeys over a stone basement, its south-west corner and its south-east corner where the photograph has them
differences.how: T-3240: the 1911 sheet's main block (12.5 x 14.7 m) on K01; its south-west corner renders on the photograph's corner pilaster (x 905) and its far corner at x 1592, the cornice's bed at the pilaster's capital

differences.what: the two-storey stone bay on the front's south part, two round-headed lights a storey in its face, its own cornice under the main one
differences.how: T-3240: K08's canted bay in stone at v 10.4, 3.6 m at the wall, 1.2 m out, two storeys to 8.6 m under a low tin hip; it renders over the photograph's bay within about 20 px. The sheet and the fit place its junctions up to about 2.5 m apart (the camera's solve); laid between them

differences.what: round-headed lights on both storeys of the front and of the south flank's upper storey, the flank's single light and its pair over the lower south range, and the pair toward the rear on both storeys
differences.how: T-3240: K01's round heads on the front (street_front_round_heads) and the read lights on the south wall (north_bays in the K01 frame), sills about 2.6 and 6.75 m

differences.what: the light stone window hoods, eared and crested, over every light
differences.how: T-1876's carving: built as K01's round head with its key block

differences.what: the stone quoin pilasters with carved capitals on the corners and at the bay
the deep cornice on paired brackets round the main block
differences.how: T-3240: K10's bracketed cornice in pairs at 1.6 m, painted light

differences.what: the roof: slopes rising from the cornice to a flat deck railed with pierced panels, and the tall stack through its south half
differences.how: T-3241: k01_hip_deck cuts the hip (now 45 degrees) off level at 13.3 m and lays a 0.8 m rail round the deck, a pale panel pierced with a roundel every 0.5 m between posts; the rail renders over the photograph's from its north-west run to its south-east end within about 40 px (about 0.5 m at the roof, where the camera, fitted on the walls below 9.5 m, is least sure), the south stack through its south half

differences.what: the corner porch: a one-storey stone arcade on the front's north end, railed on top, and the front's recessed north part behind it
differences.how: T-3241: k01_porte_cochere's corner_porch, 5.46 m along the front from the north wall and 1.2 m out on a 2.0 m podium: a narrow and a wide arch on its front and a narrow one in its south return, an entablature at 5.65-6.2 m and a balustrade over it; its front renders over the photograph's within about 0.3 m. The recessed north part of the front behind it is not cut (the wall stands in the front's line; liberty L-k01-hibbard-1701-3241), which shows only through the arches; the photograph's slender columns, carved capitals and bracketed entablature are drawn as plain stone piers and a plain entablature: T-1876's carving

differences.what: the lower south range before the south flank: one storey over the basement, set back from the front corner, a railed balcony on top, a round-headed light under an eared hood in its west face
differences.how: T-3241: a K08 projection's range plan, 2.9 m along the flank from 1.1 m behind the front corner and 3.1 m out, its walls to 5.45 m under a moulded stone cornice and a 0.5 m balustrade, a round-headed light in its west face and a narrower one in its south face; its corner, both lights and its cornice render over the photograph's within about 0.25 m. Its parapet's pierced slots are drawn as the kit's balusters, and the stone basement band at its foot is the main block's own (open below)

differences.what: the entrance: a tall dark round arch between the porch and the bay
differences.how: the porch now stands beside it (T-3241), but the arch is not built: K07's round-arched door (double_door_deep_arch) is laid only in a K02 stone front's courses, and this front is brick, so the kit's panelled door stands under a flat head at the head of its stoop

differences.what: the cast-iron fence of interlaced loops on a stone curb along the street line, its gate pier
differences.how: T-1876's ironwork: built as K11's spear fence on its curb

differences.what: the brick's and the roof's colours
the north wall and the rear
differences.how: the camera sees the front and the south flank

differences.what: the stone basement band at the foot of the main block and the lower south range, its round-headed basement lights showing over the fence (and the porch podium's roundels)
differences.how: T-3240 and T-3241 build the walls in brick to grade and the porch's podium plain; the basement lights stand behind the fence

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236).
